title: How Much Does a Reward Model Need to Capture? Empirical Curve Toward the Unhackability Limit

original_idea.body:
# Empirical Curve Toward the Unhackability Limit

Construct proxies capturing increasing reward-component subsets; plot residual hackability vs fraction captured.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: turns the unhackability theorem into a practical reward-model design curve.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small enumerable environment, pure Python policy enumeration; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped residual-hackability-vs-fraction curve with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected foundational reward-design question, no GPU/internal access, strong external value.

novelty.reasoning: The empirical unhackability-headroom curve appears largely unexplored beyond the theorem.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The empirical hackability-vs-capture curve appears mostly novel.
